Hello Mason, I would firstly like to thank you for applying to become and admin on our servers 👍


If you say that you have played for 1.5 years and have been active, then surely you should have more Stamm points, I have seen players who have been playing for less time and have a lot more than that. I understand that you can't be on 24/7 however considering you have known the server for so long, you should have many more Stamm points. 11834 Stamm points is however still a decent amount of time.


I would like to ask that when you said "If he/she rejoin and keep insualting he will receive a "cooldown/ban" on 30 minutes." If that player then came on after the ban and proceeds, how would you deal with it?


Also, you never mentioned what server you would like to apply for, but I assume it's knife anyways?


I would like to mention a few things about you and your application as a whole.


Positives:

  • Very active on the server, should be improved on the Teamspeak and forums.
  • Generally a nice and kind person.
  • You want to help out the Dream community.
  • Very well educated in speaking German and English (Huge bonus).
  • You're honest and always alert admins if they're needed.
  • I don't believe you'll be at all biased.
  • You have played for a long time and have understand and know all the rules which benefits you greatly.
  • You have a lot of free time and can be very active on the server.

Negatives:

  • "yes i do, I really don't get mad and I don't rage" In terms of maturity, I believe you do need to act and behave more maturly and you do often lose your temper, for example when WHAT was doing his job and muted you, you argued about it when in all fairness WHAT was right. Learn to control your temper.
  • Obviously your written English could do with some improvement but obviously that's not too big of an issue.
  • Lack of experience in moderation, but you can learn just like I did.
  • You have a lot of time however, not a lot is spent on the servers.


As you can see, there are many more positives than negatives and of course negatives can always be worked on and be converted to a positive which I'm sure you can do. I beleive you would make a briliant admin however you obviously need to work on your attitude and how you carry out things.
Thank you for applying!
From me it's a.. Yes
Goodluck Mason 😄 [dgrün*]

Hello @masonALEX


I have seen and read you application, through out this post you will see me state pros and cons about you and your application, Let's not waste time and get into my points shall we?


Pros:
-You are active on the server
-You're somewhere active on teamspeak, but needs a little push.
-You're trying to combat your weakness which you said is English.
-Your activity hours are great.


Neutral Points:
-Experience is not gained by watching administrators handle the situation, it's up to you if you can handle this subject.


Moving onto the cons:
- It's your first post on the forum
-"8.I am serious when I need to be serious" admin has to be serious mostly but should let players have fun too.
-You used to trigger people not recently ago which puts you in the negative spot light.
-You said you have been playing for 1.5 years but when I joined the community and the servers I did not see you around, How can you proof to us you played here for 1.5 years and having only 11k stamm points?
-"Not easily offended" I have seen you get offended before.
-"i have respect for every one it's not matter if your 10 years old or 30" You used to be nasty to @WHAT before.



I have to say NO at this moment as the cons tipped the scale for me, don't worry only because I'm on negative side it does not mean that you're already crossed out from this position.



Wish you luck with this application.





Kind Regards



Michal "OxygeN" J.
